label: D2 after a common a2 -> S2 transition during an a2 streak, early/mid episode only
explanation: 92% of activation mass is at D2 with S2 shown (reached via a2, common), and almost all the rest is at GO when the agent is about to choose a2 after an unrewarded trial. It never fires at D1, never with S1 shown or after a1 (only a handful of exceptions), and never on rewarded-input steps. It is strongly gated by episode time: rate is about 10% in trials 10-50, falls off by trial 60, and is zero after trial 70, so the unit seems to drift out of range late in the episode. Within D2 S2 it is restricted to a2 streaks (prev_action is not a1) and to high model value (value > 7.9 gives F1 0.74 dev). D2 a2->S2 alone has F1 0.48; adding ep_trial < 60 and no a1 on the previous trial gives F1 0.71, mass recall 0.92. Remaining false positives are a2->S2 trials where the agent had recently been choosing a1 or the value is low. Every variable is observed at D2 (action and state are both known there), so this predicate uses no future variables. Magnitude: the largest activations are on rare a1->S2 trials during a long a2 streak (core rare rewarded) and on later trials of a2 streaks; magnitude tends to grow over consecutive a2 trials. I did not check this quantitatively.
